purpose: Independent practice of C2.3 (equivalent expressions for whole numbers to 100).
student_learning_goal: I can find many equivalent expressions for the same whole number up to 100.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find many equivalent expressions for the same whole number up to 100.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dee in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: List 8 different expressions that equal 50. Mix addition and subtraction.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Eight numbered expression slots.

image_placeholders.description: Eight numbered expression slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each slot pre-printed: '50 = ___'. Header 'Make 50:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_M50: keywords (make) name what the slots ask for.

parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Six numbered expression slots.

image_placeholders.description: Six numbered expression slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each slot pre-printed: '100 = ___'. Header 'Make 100:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_M100: keywords (make) name what the slots ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a target number between 60 and 100. List 5 different expressions for it.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A target slot and 5 numbered expression slots.

image_placeholders.description: A target-and-5-slot box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Top: 'My target: ___'. Below: 5 numbered expression slots. Header 'Pick Your Target:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_PICK: keywords (target) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Child picks any target 60-100 and lists 5 different expressions.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, list 5 expressions for a target above 100.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet practices C2.3. Watch for children listing the same expression repeatedly. Push for variety — different addend pairs.
